title: The Call of Heavenly Fate
next_chapter_hook: As Chen Tianming's final words dissipated into the void, Chen Ji felt the burning sensation in his chest grow increasingly intense—the Tianji Record was frantically warning him that the Heavenly Eye had already detected the anomaly of this moment.

text.content: In the rift of time and space, the blurry figure finally solidified completely. Chen Ji saw clearly those eyes—contours identical to his own, yet bearing the vicissitudes that even ten thousand years could not erase. This was not Chen Tianming himself, merely a fragment of consciousness imprisoned by time and space for ten thousand years, yet carrying a dying message sufficient to overturn his entire understanding.

Chen Ji's breath abruptly stopped. He saw countless scenes reflected in those eyes—a youth gazing at the starry sky atop a mountain, a young man roaring in the midst of bloody battle, a figure torn apart in the chaos of temporal currents, a wisp of remnant soul crying out in endless void. And all those scenes ultimately pointed to this moment, to him.

The ethereal figure let out a bitter laugh, echoing through the temporal and spatial rift like a sigh spanning ten thousand years. The scenes began to shift, and Chen Ji saw that youth step by step onto the path of cultivation, saw his wild joy when he obtained the Tianji Record, saw him gradually come to realize the terrifying truth behind this divine book.

dialogue.content: I am Chen Tianming, the seventeenth generational inheritor of the Tianji Record. Once, like you, I believed I was the heavens' favorite, holding the key to changing destiny. Until I discovered that truth—the Tianji Record was never a divine object, merely a pawn the Heavenly Eye has placed in the world.

text.content: Chen Ji felt his heart skip a beat. He recalled Mo Xiansheng's words that had trailed off, the deliberately avoided truths. The Heavenly Eye—that never-before-seen ultimate enemy, had been shrouding his fate from the very beginning.

dialogue.content: I wanted to break this chess game, but failed. The temporal and spatial rift tore apart my fleshly body and soul, leaving only this wisp of consciousness fragment, trapped in a cycle of ten thousand years. I watched you grow step by step, watched you make choices different from mine, you walked farther than me... but the road ahead is also far more dangerous.

text.content: Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment in his chest vibrating violently, as if responding to something. He saw that ethereal figure extend its hand toward him, the ancient and虚幻 palm revealing a complex formation pattern. That was—the dual ritual of sacrifice and inheritance.

dialogue.content: I am trapped here, unable to truly die, nor find release. But if you are willing to pay the price, I can have you inherit all my remaining power and memories, granting you the possibility to oppose the Heavenly Eye. However, this price...

text.content: The ethereal figure paused, complex emotions surfacing in those vicissitudinous eyes. Chen Ji saw the source of those emotions—guilt, reluctance, ten thousand years of loneliness and regret. He suddenly understood, this ancestor called a genius had actually been enduring torments more terrifying than death all along.

dialogue.content: The sacrifice ritual requires consuming two-thirds of your current Heavenly Fate Value, while the inheritance ritual will permanently bind your Tianji Record with my remnant soul. This means every time you have a premonition, it may awaken my residual consciousness fragment, and you will see all the pain I once experienced.

text.content: A violent fluctuation suddenly came from the temporal and spatial rift, Chen Tianming's form trembling slightly, as if some force was pulling at him. Chen Ji saw the light in his ancestor's eyes fading, that consciousness fragment being gradually eroded by temporal chaos.

dialogue.content: Time is running out, child. Make your choice. Whatever you choose, I will not blame you. But there is one thing I must tell you—the Heavenly Eye has already detected our conversation, and it will act soon. You must grow stronger as quickly as possible, otherwise...

text.content: Chen Ji felt the burning sensation in his chest growing even more intense. The Tianji Record was warning frantically, indicating some terrifying existence was gazing at him. That was the Heavenly Eye—that ultimate chess player had finally turned its gaze toward this rebellious piece.

choice.prompt: Chen Tianming's form wavered in the temporal chaos, his consciousness fragment being gradually eroded. He awaited your answer—this decision will affect the direction of your future destiny.

choices.description: Inherit the Ancestor's power and memories, even if it means bearing double Heavenly Fate consumption and endless suffering.
choices.visible_reward: Gained Chen Tianming's remnant soul power, Tianji Record functions enhanced
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may therefore accelerate its encirclement and suppression of you

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, slowly kneeling on one knee before his startled ancestor. His voice was calm and resolute, echoing in the temporal and spatial rift: 'Ancestor, you paid the price of ten thousand years for breaking this chess game. I have no reason to retreat.'

dialogue.content: Chen Tianming fell silent for a moment, and a touch of emotion appeared in those vicissitudinous eyes: 'Good child... you are more suitable to bear this fate than me.' The ethereal form began turning into dots of light, flowing toward Chen Ji.

choices.description: Do not bind yourself to the ancestor's remnant soul, seek other ways to grow stronger, and do not take this path destined to be full of pain.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the opportunity to inherit Chen Tianming's power
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independence, avoid extra attention from the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. He looked at the anticipation in his ancestor's eyes, yet felt no fluctuation in his heart. It was not that he was unwilling to sacrifice, but that he could not—he still had too many unfinished matters, still had Chen Nian to find, still had Su Qingyao and Ye Qing to protect.

dialogue.content: Chen Tianming looked at his grandchild's gaze, and a sense of relief appeared in those vicissitudinous eyes: 'I understand. You are different from me, you have things you must protect. This is good... this is very good.'

choices.description: Neither blindly accept nor simply refuse, but try to find a method that can help the ancestor without completely binding oneself.
choices.visible_cost: Need to pay extra costs to find this path
choices.risk_hint: Time is pressing, may not be able to find the answer before the ancestor dissipates

text.content: A gleam of sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. He never made choices without a way out. The Tianji Record frantically turned in his mind, searching for any possible loopholes. And just then, he noticed a key point—Mo Xiansheng.

dialogue.content: Chen Tianming's form grew increasingly faint, but upon hearing his grandchild's words, a glimmer of hope appeared in his eyes: 'Mo Xiansheng... yes, he is the board guardian I left behind. If anyone knows of a third possibility, it is him. I can pass my final consciousness fragment to him, letting him guide you.'

text.content: The temporal and spatial rift violently shook again, Chen Tianming's form had become so faint it was nearly transparent. His voice came from an extremely distant place, carrying ten thousand years of vicissitudes and exhaustion: 'Child, whatever choice you make, remember—the true power of the Tianji Record does not lie in foresight, but in the courage to change the future.'

Chen Ji watched the final light of his ancestor dissipating. Those eyes similar to his own showed a tranquility never seen in ten thousand years. He suddenly understood—this soul trapped for ten thousand years had actually been waiting for release all along, waiting for someone to inherit his will and complete his unfinished endeavor.

dialogue.content: Our destiny was a fraud from the beginning, the Heavenly Eye used us as chess pieces for ten thousand years. But you are different—you have the ability to break this chess game. Go, my child. End this ancient chess game and let all people no longer be manipulated by fate.

text.content: Chen Ji watched his ancestor's final form completely dissipate in time and space, and an indescribable sorrow and excitement rose in his heart. He looked down at the fragment on his chest and found a line of blurry text added to it—that was the final message Chen Tianming left, guiding him to a certain place to find Mo Xiansheng.

The temporal and spatial rift began to contract, and Chen Ji felt a powerful force pulling him toward the real world. In the instant his consciousness was about to return to his body, he heard a low voice—the voice of the Heavenly Eye, carrying eternal coldness and scrutiny: 'Interesting little thing, you actually resonated with that wisp of remnant soul. Very well, let me see how far you can go.'
